# Astra local fonts

Self-hosted Latin subsets for offline Astra gallery / demos.
Source: Fontsource packages `@5.3.0` (OFL / Apache — see `LICENSE`).

| CSS | Families | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gallery.css` | IBM Plex Mono 400/500/600, Syne 500–800 | `gpt6-astra/index.html` |
| `dm-space.css` | DM Sans + Space Grotesk 400/500/600/700 | `3d-sailing`, `3d-fill-the-void` |
| `exhibition.css` | DM Sans + Manrope variable (wght) | `exhibition-web` |

CJK in the gallery falls back to system UI fonts (these families are Latin-only).
No Google Fonts CDN refs remain under `gpt6-astra/`.
